title: Deep eutectic solvent extraction of Tremella fuciformis polysaccharide and the extract's antioxidant activity.
authors: Wan, Zemin; Wang, Kai; Wu, Jili; Luo, Zhen; Li, Shaofei; Liu, Huiping; Zhang, Xuewu
journal: Journal of the science of food and agriculture
one_liner_zh: 该文研究银耳多糖的深共熔溶剂提取及其抗氧化活性，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合建模完全无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: No study has, until now, examined the deep eutectic solvent (DES) extraction of Tremella fuciformis polysaccharide (TFP). In this study, a DES composed of choline chloride and citric acid (1:1 molar ratio) was prepared for TFP extraction. Artificial neural network optimization based on genetic and sparrow search algorithms was applied, yielding the polysaccharide TFP-1 with an average molecular weight of 13 152 Da. RESULTS: The TFP-1 polysaccharide exhibited a triple-helix structure, and its polymer chains comprised glucose, mannose, xylose, and galactose in a molar ratio of 90.82:5.68:3.06:0.44. The main chain structure was -->(6)-beta-d-Glcp-(1-->, -->4)-alpha-d-Glcp-(1-->, -->3,6)-alpha-d-Glcp-(1-->, -->4,6)-alpha-d-Glcp-(1-->). In a cigarette smoke extract (CSE)-induced oxidative injury cell model, the TFP-1-based extract (TFP-1-E) decreased interleukin-6 (IL-6), tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha), and nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) levels, while increasing superoxide dismutase (SOD), glutathione peroxidase (GPx), and catalase (CAT) activity at 50-100 mug mL(-)(1) compared with the model group. RNA sequencing (RNA-Seq) analysis identified 1343 differentially expressed genes between the CSE and TFP-1-E groups, which were primarily mapped to a five-gene sub-network comprising CARD17, CARD18, CASP1, MINDY3, and MINDY2. CONCLUSION: These data suggest that TFP-1-E could alleviate inflammation and oxidative stress and could be used for the development of functional foods or biomedicines. abstract_zh: 背景：迄今为止，尚无研究探讨深共熔溶剂（DES）提取银耳多糖（TFP）。本研究制备了一种由氯化胆碱和柠檬酸组成的深共熔溶剂（摩尔比1:1），用于TFP提取。采用基于遗传算法和麻雀搜索算法的人工神经网络优化，获得平均分子量为13 152 Da的多糖TFP-1。结果：TFP-1多糖呈现三螺旋结构，其聚合物链由葡萄糖、甘露糖、木糖和半乳糖组成，摩尔比为90.82:5.68:3.06:0.44。主链结构为-->6)-β-d-Glcp-(1-->、-->4)-α-d-Glcp-(1-->、-->3,6)-α-d-Glcp-(1-->、-->4,6)-α-d-Glcp-(1-->。在香烟烟雾提取物（CSE）诱导的氧化损伤细胞模型中，与模型组相比，基于TFP-1的提取物（TFP-1-E）在50-100 μg mL⁻¹浓度下降低了白细胞介素-6（IL-6）、肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）和核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）水平，同时增加了超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GPx）和过氧化氢酶（CAT）活性。RNA测序（RNA-Seq）分析鉴定出CSE组和TFP-1-E组之间1343个差异表达基因，这些基因主要映射到一个包含CARD17、CARD18、CASP1、MINDY3和MINDY2的五基因子网络。结论：这些数据表明，TFP-1-E可缓解炎症和氧化应激，并可用于功能性食品或生物医药的开发。（c）2025化学工业学会。
